paper_title: Search for hidden-photon cold dark matter using a K-band cryogenic receiver
notes: Dish-antenna-type HP-CDM search (planar aluminum plate + cryogenic K-band receiver). Excludes chi = 1.8-4.3e-10 over 115.79-115.85 ueV (27.998-28.012 GHz) at 95% CL. Exact bin-by-bin limits only in Figure 7; the two emitted points span the stated mass range with the quoted min/max chi values, so the fine structure of the limit is not captured. Local DM density 0.39 +/- 0.03 GeV/cm^3 (Catena & Ullio) used, though eq. (1.3) is normalized to 0.3 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
